steps.help: Step 1 of 8: The Assignments page shows all current and past assignments. Click "Create Assignment" to distribute a form to countries.
Step 2 of 8: Select which form template you want to distribute. Only active templates with published versions appear in this list.
Step 3 of 8: Select one or more countries to receive this assignment. You can select all countries or pick specific ones.
Step 4 of 8: Give this assignment a descriptive period name (e.g., "Q1 2024 Data Collection" or "Annual Report 2024"). This helps identify the assignment later.
Step 5 of 8: Choose a deadline for data submission. Focal points will see this deadline and receive reminders as it approaches.
Step 6 of 8: Provide any special instructions or context for this assignment. This message will be shown to focal points.
Step 7 of 8: If you want to allow public submissions without login, check this option. You can activate or deactivate the public URL later.
Step 8 of 8: Review the assignment details and click "Create Assignment". Focal points will be notified and see the new task in their dashboard.
